groups.statement: The filer prints percent of net assets to one decimal; the rows that differ from fair value over net assets by more than 0.1 are the filer's own printed figures. Published is the page.
Spreads are printed including a credit spread adjustment, so they are not quarter-point values.
The spread of 16.00 on Evolve Biologics is the printed spread. (2023-03-31 is not included: the Vice Group Holding spreads of 15.0 in that quarter were not read.)
Leaves counted without a fair value are comparative-period rows and contexts that carry no fair value fact; the published total equals the filed total.

evidence.quote: 2023-03-31: 691 of 1,692 leaves have a fair value; of 200 sampled others 103 are comparative-period rows and 97 have no fair value fact, e.g. '300 N. Michigan Mezz, LLC (Delayed Draw), Senior Secured Loans, Due 7/15/2024' (reading, group 13).

groups.statement: The check compares rows by issuer name and values. With the tranche words taken out of the name (D-101), two undrawn or zero-value lines of one issuer look alike; they are different members and both are printed.

evidence.quote: Sandbox mo1c, 2025-12-31: Mooring Primary, LLC '(Delayed Draw) | Senior Secured Loans' and '(Revolver) | Senior Secured Loans', both fair value 0 and commitment 6,333,000; Arcserve Cayman GP LLC '(Class A common units)' and '(Class B common units)', both 0 (scratch/2026-10-11_monroe/dup.sql).
